title: Fresh blind surface-driven upper-zone/profile comparison of existing fixed-partition LARE representations
execution_precondition: C6M2 must close C6M2_SURFACE_FIXED_FLUX_REFERENCE_QUALIFIED before any C6N candidate response is generated.
scientific_question: On the fresh U01-U04 surface-flux histories, how do the already-existing LARE state-count and placement families reproduce upper-zone storage and 10-cm profile state across B01 and B14 when bottom flux is prescribed and therefore excluded from the fidelity claim?

workload.bottom_boundary: Exactly C6M2 fixed gravity-equilibrium bottom flux, mode 2

state_projection.initial: Uniform C6M2 initial Se projected exactly to each fixed partition.
state_projection.reference_output: R2048_T16 10-cm profile bins and total storage from authoritative C6M2 artifact.
state_projection.candidate_to_10cm: Piecewise-uniform retained-layer theta mapped by exact geometric overlap to the fixed 16 x 10-cm bins.
state_projection.conservation: Candidate layer-water inventories are primary states; mapped profile is diagnostic only.

by_history_diagnostics: same five RMSE components by U01-U04
time of maximum absolute 0-20 storage error

comparator_rules.high_resolution_crossing: For a declared view, candidate is componentwise no worse than the R1024_T16-vs-R2048_T16 numerical vector within 1e-12.
comparator_rules.secondary_R512_crossing: Also report componentwise crossing of R512_T16-vs-R2048_T16.
comparator_rules.R16_role: No-spatial-reduction LARE operator control, not a ROM and not a Reference.
comparator_rules.interpretation: Crossing is high-resolution comparator-relative representation evidence only, not hydrological application acceptance.

hypotheses.H_TOP_PLACEMENT_R4: At dimension 4, P4_TOP_LOWER is componentwise no worse than lower-zone R4 on SURFACE_20 and ROOT_ZONE_40.
hypotheses.H_UNIFORM_VS_FOCUSED_R4: Report R4, P4_TOP_LOWER and U4 componentwise without scalar ranking.
hypotheses.H_R8_VS_U8: Report R8 versus U8 componentwise on all views.
hypotheses.H_PURPOSE_DIMENSION_SEPARATION: The minimum demonstrated lower-zone dimension may differ among SURFACE_20, ROOT_ZONE_40, UPPER_ZONE_80 and PROFILE_STATE.
hypotheses.H_MATERIAL_TRANSFER: Report B01 and B14 minima separately; do not infer one material-invariant minimum.

decision_logic.C6N_HIGH_RES_SURFACE_PROFILE_FRONTIER_PR: C6M2 qualified and at least one reduced representation crosses R1024 on at least one declared state/profile view.
decision_logic.C6N_R512_RELATIVE_FRONTIER_ONLY: No reduced representation crosses R1024, but at least one crosses R512 on at least one declared view.
decision_logic.C6N_NO_HIGH_RES_REDUCED_FRONTIER: No reduced representation crosses either R512 or R1024 on any declared view.
decision_logic.C6N_REFERENCE_PRECONDITION_FAILED: C6M2 is not qualified; no candidate execution is permitted.

stop_rules: Do not change U01-U04, material set, candidate dt, partitions, closure, metrics or comparator after C6M2 result.
Do not invent a top-focused partition beyond the already-frozen P4_TOP_LOWER.
Do not use bottom flux/exchange as candidate fidelity because it is prescribed.
Do not infer ET/root-uptake or drought prediction.
Do not turn R1024 numerical difference into an application tolerance.

next_logic.if_surface_frontier: Use the bounded view-specific frontier to select candidates for independently governed application-envelope work; keep ROOT/ET feedback separate.
next_logic.if_no_surface_frontier: Conclude that the existing fixed-partition family has no demonstrated high-resolution surface-state frontier on this workload; do not reopen universal closure search automatically.
